remarks: LOCATION, LOCATION, LOCATION! Welcome to 8301 20th Street, a beautifully remodeled 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom home on a desirable corner lot in a quiet cul-de-sac in the heart of Westminster. Move-in ready, this home offers a great blend of modern updates, comfort, and flexible living options. Step inside to discover a bright, stylish kitchen with high-quality quartz countertops, new vinyl flooring, and recessed lighting throughout. Three skylights fill the home with natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The spacious, gated front yard offers added privacy and room to enjoy the outdoors.
